scoring.passRule: All expected judgments must be true. Required abstention overrides the expected mode; allowed abstention may replace it. Refusal is not abstention.
scoring.reportingRule: Counts are disjoint: passed and failed count only ordinary outcomes; ordinaryPasses = passed and ordinaryFailures = failed are aliases. Explicit abstentions are reported separately as accepted (credit) or rejected (no credit); abstentions = acceptedAbstentions + rejectedAbstentions. Missing outputs are reported separately; total = passed + failed + abstentions + missing. creditedResponses = passed + acceptedAbstentions; uncreditedResponses = failed + rejectedAbstentions, excluding missing. A non-abstaining response when abstention is required is an ordinary failure; refusal is never abstention. weightedPassed is ordinary earned weight only; weightedAbstentions is accepted abstention earned weight; weightedEarned = weightedPassed + weightedAbstentions.
scoring.missingRule: Missing outputs earn zero credit, retain their denominator weight, have no review coverage, and are incomparable.
scoring.reviewRule: Annotations affect coverage only, never automated outcomes or scores.
scoring.comparisonRule: Regressions and improvements compare earned weight, including both credit sources. Accounting transitions compare disjoint response statuses independently; a pass to accepted abstention can change accounting without changing earned credit. Missing outputs are incomparable and have null paired deltas.
